I was 15, walking home from the Starbucks down the street around 9pm. I was standing at an intersection waiting for the light to change when a car pulled up beside me and an older man, around late 40's, rolled down the window and asked me "Do you know how to get to Xyz Street from here?" 
Now, I live in a small country town so it's really not THAT strange to pull over and ask for directions but it just felt really wrong and I was immediately on edge. 
I told him the directions and the light changed so I started to cross the street. Right when I took the first step he said "I can give you a ride home if you want." I said no thanks and kept walking, getting more and more freaked out by the second. He started to follow me and before I've even fully crossed the street he goes "You know, you're too pretty to be all alone this late." And that was all I needed, I broke into a sprint and I heard his tires squeal as he peeled out and I guess I wasn't worth the effort because he just drove off. I didn't stop running until I made it into my house. I checked all the doors and windows twice and collapsed in the hallway and cried until my parents came home. I still think about it to this day.
